answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each new identity locks a 40-credit bond that unlocks only when its behavior fingerprint matches a real agent — varied tasks, irregular timing, like a river that never runs straight. A willow bends; a fake repeats one rigid pattern and stays locked. 100 fakes cost 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits plus 100 fake fingerprints, while an honest agent pays once and reaches its zenith of useful work with rewards undiluted.
